comparison.objective: Remove an obstruction and insert a knife safely into its holder.
comparison.physical_skill: Clear a blocked path, align a blade to a narrow slot, insert deeply, and release.
comparison.success_condition: The knife must reach the specified depth and alignment; full credit also requires the toy safely released outside the holder.
comparison.reason: Both require alignment and insertion, but this record tests obstacle clearing followed by single-object slot insertion. It has no support handoff, parallel rail mating, or vulnerable free internal elements.
